# awbac

> Role-based access control that fails closed and explains itself.

Most authz answers "no" without saying why, so every denial becomes a debugging session — and the ones that fail OPEN never announce themselves at all.

## Install

```
pip install awbac
```

## Use it in 30 seconds

Gate one endpoint and read the explanation it gives for a denial.

## Composes with

- [awdit](https://aitherium.github.io/awdit/) — An append-only audit trail whose gaps are DETECTABLE.

## Where it lives

- Repo: https://github.com/Aitherium/awbac
- Docs: https://aitherium.github.io/awbac/
- Manifest (keys + the one-line adoption story): https://aitherium.github.io/awbac/aither-manifest.json

This repository is mirrored from the AitherOS monorepo by `.github/workflows/sync-awbac.yml`; hand edits made here are overwritten on the next sync — change the source instead.

Everything Aitherium, in one file for agents: https://aitherium.com/llms.txt
